name: Hoshiumi Koyoi
source:
Koyoi is shy and introverted. Her unique feature is that she speaks in Kansai dialect. She and [url=/c98234]Tsuyuri[/url] are cousins; she calls Tsuyuri "Tsuyu-chan". Due to her shy personality, she hasn't had many chances to talk with men before, and the [url=/c98200]Protagonist[/url] is the one person she can talk to the most.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
